_comment: World systems (cooks/build-world-systems.md): shrines, path masters and their quests, villages and factions, the traveling merchants and their trade, message stones, world and biome events, invasions, hidden sub-biomes, summoning stones. Positions are metres on the island (x east, y south); every one is settled on land at runtime (traced down, stepped toward the island's middle if it lands in the sea), so a rebuilt island needs no re-placement. A new biome adds rows; nothing in code names a biome. Numbers are first drafts.

fungal.name: Fungal caverns
fungal._why: cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.1: limestone grey #A7A498 pavement over caverns lit by cyan glow-moss #39E6C2; the waymark is the Deepfarmers' glow-cap ring (world-map SPEC).

crystal.name: Crystal caves
crystal._why: cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.1: columnar basalt #1C1C20 / #2A2A30 over amethyst #6B3FA0, the crystals' lilac-white glow #D8D0FF; the waymark is the Wardcarvers' chime-stone arch (build-biome-crystal 2.5). centre: the plateau's middle over the Organ (map metres on the Crystal land's frame).

ocean.name: Ocean and reefs
ocean._why: cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.1-2.2: coral limestone gold #C9A46A and its shade, accent the Tide path's sea-green #1E8C86, glow the phosphor paint / Glowray blue-green #5AE0C8; centre = the Inlet camp by the Dyke Head and the Gate Inlet.

sky_islands.name: Sky islands
sky_islands._why: cooks/biome-sky.md 2.1: white granite #C9C4BA and its grey, accent the Wind path's pale teal #9FD6CF, glow levistone cyan; centre = the Lift Steps between the three camps and the Still Pool.

graveyard.name: Graveyard
graveyard._why: cooks/biome-graveyard.md 2.1: limestone #B4AFA4 and grey #8A8580, accent the path colour bone-green #A8B89A, glow soul-green grave-light #9FE3C0; centre = the grave fields' middle between the Lychgate Chapel and the Belfry.

biomes._comment: Per biome: its path, signature resource, essence, faction, the crater / glacier the event centres on, and the waymark round its summoning stones.

forest.name: Ancient forest
forest._why: cooks/biome-forest.md 2.1-2.2, cooks/build-biome-forest.md 2.12: rock = old stone #8A8478 under moss #4E6B2A, accent = moss green #5E8C31, glow = the Four Hearts' amber sap #D08A1E; centre = the old growth's middle (the Bloom and the starfall settle round it).

shrines._comment: great: a village's always-lit shrine with its path master. guards: creature id -> how many, spawned round a dark lesser shrine when someone comes near.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Tithe Mound
list._why: Low bone mound, a stone tithe basin, a ring of 7 fetish posts; the brazier a bronze bowl of bloodmoss oil burning low and dark red. Placed from Data/swamp.json shrines (WRSwampSystems).

list.name: Salt Cross Shrine
list._why: A cross of salt-crusted driftwood on a reed island (M1).

list.name: Root Shrine
list._why: A root-altar at the channel crossroads under the Mangrove Cathedral (M2).

list.name: Cage Shrine
list._why: A brazier inside an iron cage at the Hanging Cypress's foot (M4).

list.name: Falls Shrine
list._why: A bone brazier under the spray of the Weeping Wall's middle fall (M5).

list.name: Great Shrine: the Shrine of the Edge
list._why: biome-void 2.11: at the Quiet Rift, a small old steady rift ringed by the seated listeners (S12). The brazier is a black iron bowl on a tripod, outside the tear's 6 m pull and inside its zone: you feel lighter while you kindle it.

list.name: Greywood Shrine
list._why: V1: a ring of point-down cairns round a dead pine; Gnawer swarms by day, Hollowfangs join them at night.

list.name: Strand Shrine
list._why: V2: a Choir watch post on the dunes; the Riftback is neutral until hit.

list.name: Severance West Shrine
list._why: V4: the pass shrine beside the Hollow Fort's gate (two of its Hollowfangs come Riftborn: WRVoidWorld).

list.name: East Gate Shrine
list._why: V5: a horned gateway arch at the Gauntlet Road's start.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Grove Circle
list._why: cooks/biome-forest.md 2.11: nine pleached limes round a stone bowl on a living root pedestal, inside the Grovekin Long-hall; the brazier burns heartwood resin with an amber smoke. Placed from Data/forest.json shrines (WRForestShape::ShrineSpot); its footing is WRForestSceneryKit ShrineGroveCircle. Rowan Ashby works here by day.

list.name: Hedge Shrine
list._why: A stone niche in an ancient hedgerow with a carved hulder face in its lintel (F1, the meadows). A sounder of Trufflers roots round it.

list.name: Falls Shrine
list._why: On the Grovekin fishing platform in the Great Falls' pool, in the spray (F2): it stands on the platform's deck (ShrineSpot), a young Rootcoil in the shallows.

list.name: Nurse Shrine
list._why: A brazier in the hollow of the Nurse Log's broken end (F4), soot-black inside, amber resin on the lip. Two Thornlynx lie up on the log.

list.name: Canopy Shrine
list._why: A brazier on a walkway platform 30 m up a giant (F5), reached by the Canopy Lift and its walkways; it stands on the deck (ShrineSpot: forest.json deck 30 m).

list.name: Great Shrine of the Hexafoil
list._why: biome-crystal 2.11: C5 W2, a square chamber whose floor is one hexafoil 8 m across inlaid in bronze; no guard (Saga Venn works here). floor: it stands on the chamber's floor 90 m under the sea's level, not the plateau above.

list.name: Cliff Bell Shrine
list._why: C1 by D2: a brazier under a bronze bell on a basalt frame at the cliff; a Lumenhorn herd grazes round it (neutral: don't provoke).

list.name: Geode Shrine
list._why: C2 G3: a brazier on the agate rind ledge in an amethyst hall; a Geodemite nest's two swarms.

list.name: Beam Shrine
list._why: C3 L4: a brazier lashed to the Hall of Beams' central beam above the steam; a Spindleglass stalks the beams.

list.name: Severance Shrine
list._why: The pass mouth: a brazier inside the Hollowed Giantess's ward cage, before the Severance Gate; a Prismback and an Echobat.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Lantern
list._why: GY 2.11: in the Lychgate Chapel's yard beside camp 2 (the draft's ruined chapel is Nhal's arena: a master can't stand in a boss lair). Lit with a toro's grave-light instead of a brazier.

list.name: The Seven Names
list._why: G2, before the great mausoleum: a Gravehound pack, Wraithmoths at night (the Palestrider herd by day is neutral).

list.name: The Lime Kilns
list._why: G3, by the warm kiln: a Gravehound pack of four and a Tombback.

list.name: Foot of the Stair
list._why: G4, beside the stone gate: a Cryptstalker (highland, solo) and two Wraithmoths.

list.name: The Watchers' Vault
list._why: G5 (the catacombs' L1), C1: the watchers' chairs facing the great door. It stands on the room's floor (room C1 in Data/graveyard.json), not the ground above.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Still Pool
list._why: cooks/biome-sky.md 2.13: W1 Still Pool Isle (560 m) above camp 2's lift: Yara Kesh's open workshop, the Aethercarp pool, the Wind Rose (eight carved winds round the floor). No guards (the path master).

list.name: Gardens Shrine
list._why: W2 Moss Stair: a Gallowshrike pack (3) and a Sailbell bloom drifting through.

list.name: Toll Shrine
list._why: W3 Last Toll: two Galeharriers and a Windmane herd gone aggressive while the shrine is dark. Lit, it lights the Fallen Span's lanterns.

list.name: Rose Shrine
list._why: W4 Rose Temple: a Skyray off the lip and a Gallowshrike pair. The Spore invasion's target.

list.name: Barrow Shrine
list._why: W5 Kite Barrow (the Undercloud, hidden): two Hushwings, one roosting, one hunting.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Garden Doline
list._why: biome-fungal 2.11: on the Garden Doline's floor (F2, D1's foot) in the daylight shaft: a ring of 7 caps 4 m tall round a stone basin where a deepcap grows in water; the brazier a bowl of glow-moss oil burning cold cyan. No guard (Ilmari Kask works here). floor: it stands on the doline's floor 40 m over the sea, not the plateau.

list.name: Ring Shrine
list._why: F1 inside L3 the Ring of Caps: the altar stone with a cold-light brazier; the Tunnel toads that sit in the ring defend it.

list.name: Starfall Shrine
list._why: F3 at the False Sky's edge: a brazier on a flowstone column under the starfield; a Webspinner pair hunts the lines over it.

list.name: Cable Shrine
list._why: F4 at the Shoestring Bridge's west anchor: a brazier lashed into the cable's roots; a Sporestalker and a Mycomite swarm.

list.name: Flue Floor Shrine
list._why: The pass mouth (world-map): on the Fall Field at the Flue's floor, a brazier in a ring of fallen kite spars beside the champion; a Rotmaw and Mycomites scavenge the falls.

list.name: Great Shrine of the Mirror Pool
list._why: cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.11: O2 beside the Tide Clock, a round Saltkin tide pool 12 m across carved into a basin, its brazier a bronze bowl on a stone post in the water, a whale-oil flame burning sea-green on the mirror. No guards (Hae-won's stilt house stands over it).

list.name: Driftwood Shrine
list._why: O1 beside the Driftwood Chapel: a driftwood brazier hung with shell chimes; a Spinecrab pair buried round it and Gullraiders over it.

list.name: Gate Shrine
list._why: O3 at Saltgate's east mouth (the pass shrine, one of the five): a Saltkin brazier in a ring of bollards on the salt flat; Spinecrabs (the Desert's Glasstail and Dunejaw join them at the mouth when the Desert is live).

list.name: Kelp Stack Shrine
list._why: O4, on top of a 14 m sea stack you climb out of the water to: a brazier in a cleft on the top, gulls all round; a young Reefjaw circles the stack and Tidecoils hold its foot.

list.name: Lighthouse Shrine
list._why: O5 in the Reef Lighthouse's broken lamp room (up the stair inside), ladles clinking at every sill; Tidecoils in the tower, a Reefjaw in the surf.

lines.first: Another one off the boats. Stand clear of the sparks.
lines.all: You've the forge in you now. Go and use it.

lines.first: Quiet. You walk like a herd.
lines.all: The ice will carry you now.

masters.name: Vesna Groza
masters._why: The path master of Lightning (cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.13): a climber struck on the Crown who came down alive, a Lichtenberg fern from her left shoulder to her jaw. By day she sharpens pitons at her lean-to in Strikerock's split beside the Great Shrine; the tap of the work loop is the file on the piton.

lines.first: Hair standing up yet? It will. Stay low on the Crown.
lines.offer: Want to learn to live up there? Ha. Then listen.
lines.waiting: Still here? The sky won't wait for you.
lines.all: You've the storm in you now. Go up and bring it down.

masters.name: Ruslana
masters._why: The Mire-witch, path master of Blood & curse (cooks/biome-swamp.md 2.11): a newcomer who washed ashore and taught herself the Coven's craft from its bones and books. Early 30s, tall, striking: black hair in a long rope braid threaded with crow feathers and bone beads, sharp cheekbones, dark-lined grey eyes, lips and fingertips stained garnet with bloodmoss dye; a fitted black-green leather bodice laced at the front over an open-collared undershirt, bare shoulders under a crow-feather mantle, a split wrap skirt over tall waders, a belt of bottles and bone charms. Confident, amused, dangerous. By day at the Tithe Mound grinding bloodmoss, by night at the Walking House (WRSwampSystems moves her).

lines.first: You smell of the coast. That'll change.
lines.offer: Want the Mire's craft? It costs a little blood. Everything here does.
lines.waiting: Still dry? The water won't wait.
lines.done: There. The Mire took its share and you're still standing.
lines.all: You bleed like one of them now. Go and feed her nothing.

masters.name: Saga Venn
masters._why: The Rune-Carver (biome-crystal 2.11): a newcomer, a stonemason before the wreck, blind years in the caves (a clean white scar across both eyelids); she reads a ward by tapping it and listening. Late 30s, tall, a carver's shoulders and forearms dusted with crystal powder, her own violet rune lines faint on both forearms; black hair with one silver streak braided over a shoulder. A sleeveless deep-violet leather jerkin over linen, a carver's apron, bronze tools at her belt, barefoot on the hexafoil. By day she carves a keystone plate at the Great Shrine (work: a chisel's tap); at night she sits at the hexafoil's edge striking a fork and listening (UWRCrystalWorld moves her when no one is near).

lines.first: Stop. Let me hear you. ...You walk loud. The halls will like you.
lines.offer: Want to learn to cut what they cut? Then listen first. Everything here starts with listening.
lines.waiting: Still here. I can hear your boots thinking about it.
lines.done: There. That's the sound of it done right.
lines.all: You're quieter than you were. Go and hear what the Vault keeps.

masters.name: Maren Vey
masters._why: The one who came back (biome-void 2.11): a newcomer about 32, tall and lean from salvaging wrecks, one white-grey streak in dark hair, her left eye black to the iris edge and her left forearm grey to the elbow (the Void body change at full, worn as a fact). A Hollowplate cuirass over a loose linen shirt open at the throat, sleeves rolled. She lives at the Great Shrine below the Quiet Rift: a bedroll, a lantern, a slate of counted marks. Low voice, dry and warm; looks at you a beat too long.

lines.first: You feel lighter here. That's not a good thing.
lines.offer: Want to learn what the edge gives? Sleep gives it back. Mostly.
lines.waiting: Still whole? Go and lose a little.
lines.done: There. You came back. Most don't.
lines.all: Empty enough now. Don't sing near the big one.

masters.name: Rowan Ashby
masters._why: The path master of Nature, the hermit (cooks/biome-forest.md 2.11): a newcomer who walked off his ship ten years before you and learned the Grovekin's craft from their gardens, carvings and graves. Mid 30s, tall, lean from climbing, a close dark beard, long dark-brown hair tied back with a leather cord, sun lines at his eyes; an open-collared linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a herbalist's leather apron with pouches and a pruning knife. By day he tends the Grove Circle's limes and grinds resin there (this spot, inside the Long-hall); at dusk he walks home to the house in the Hermit's Oak's fork, and back at dawn (UWRForestWorld::StepRowan moves him while nobody is near).

lines.first: Mind the brambles. They mind you.
lines.offer: You walk like you mean to cut something. Sit a while first.
lines.waiting: The forest isn't going anywhere. Neither am I.
lines.all: You hear it now, don't you. Go on. It knows your step.

masters.name: Morwen
masters._why: The path master of Necromancy, the Lantern-keeper (GY 2.11): the last newcomer who stayed, late 20s, tall and strong-shouldered from lifting stone, a long black braid, the full ash-pale Necromancy change (a 100-point Necromancer: where the path goes). A fitted black waistcoat over a loose white shirt open at the throat, sleeves rolled, a leather apron, high boots, a lantern on her belt, soulstone earrings. By day she trims wicks at the Lychgate Chapel's lantern rack; at dusk she carries a lantern to the Row of the Named; at dawn she sits on the lychgate step (WRGraveWorld moves her). Dry, calm, a little amused.

lines.first: They were lit when I got here. I just never let them go out.
lines.offer: You want the path? It wants you back. Keep a light with you.
lines.waiting: Still breathing? Good. The dead are patient; I am not.
lines.done: There. That one will stay lit a while.
lines.all: You see it now. Nobody's in these graves. Go up the Stair and tell me why.

masters.name: Yara Kesh
masters._why: The path master of Wind, the one-winged glider-maker (SKY 2.13): about 30, lean and strong like a climber, sun-browned with freckles, a single heavy black braid the wind never leaves alone, a cropped Skysilk wrap-top and loose pale trousers, a long teal scarf, bare feet; her left arm ends below the elbow (a brass-and-levistone hook-hand she tensions glider lines with); her one-winged glider hangs over the bench (WRSkySites great_shrine). The Wind change at 75 points shows on her as a living preview. Warm, quick, teasing: she laughs at falls but not at deaths.

lines.first: New? Ha. Everyone falls once. Try to do it near me.
lines.offer: You want to learn the wind? Then stop fighting it. Here.
lines.waiting: Still on the ground? The wind won't wait for you.
lines.done: There. You came down the way you meant to. That's all flying is.
lines.all: You fly like a Kitewright now. Go and see what they bound up there.

masters.name: Ilmari Kask
masters._why: The Mushroom Farmer (biome-fungal 2.11): a newcomer, not a Deepfarmer: he came ashore years ago, found the Garden Farm and taught himself the old ways from their jars and bones. He doesn't climb. Early 30s, tall and lean with a farmer's shoulders and forearms, dark curls with mossy green tips falling over his eyes, a short beard, warm brown skin dusted with faint cyan freckles across the nose, cheeks and shoulders (his own Spore body change at 75), an easy crooked grin. An open umber leather vest over a bare chest, sleeves torn off, a belt of knives and pouches, rolled linen trousers, bare feet in the moss; a spore mask at his neck he never wears (Immune system). By day he works the log beds by the Great Shrine on the Garden Doline's floor (work: a knife at the logs); at night he sleeps in his cap-house on the terraces (UWRFungalWorld moves him when no one is near). Short lines within 6 m; quests to the Journal.

lines.first: Mind the logs. ...New? Breathe through your nose down here. The caps like a mouth-breather.
lines.offer: I can teach you to grow what grows on you. Interested?
lines.waiting: The logs don't hurry. Neither should you. But you could.
lines.done: Look at that. Something lived because of you today.
lines.all: You've the Deep in you now. Don't climb anything you can't climb down from.

masters.name: Hae-won

lines.first: Ha! Another one the sea spat out. Welcome. Don't drink it.
lines.offer: You want to learn the water? Then get in it. I'll teach you to stay alive down there first.
lines.waiting: Still dry? The sea doesn't come to you. Well. Once a while it does.
lines.done: Good. You came back up. Every time you do that, you've won.
lines.all: You move like the tide now. Go and see what's sleeping in the Pound. Then tell me.

masters._why: cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.11: the Harpooner. A newcomer who washed ashore years before you; a freediver at home (a haenyeo-style sea woman), she taught herself the Saltkin harpoon from Harpooners' Hall. Late 30s, lean and strong with broad swimmer's shoulders, sun-browned skin, long black hair with salt-bleached tips in a wet braid wound with fishing line and shark teeth, dark eyes with a sea-green ring, fine gill lines at her neck (her own Tide change at 75), a pale Reefjaw scar from hip to knee. A fitted sleeveless sharkskin dive suit cut high at the hip and open at the collar, a short sailcloth wrap skirt knotted at one hip, a dive knife strapped to her thigh, a Saltkin harpoon on her back. A warm, loud laugh; blunt; fearless. She lives in the stilt house over the Mirror Pool: dives the Kelp Cathedral at dawn, mends lines by the pool by day (work), sits on her porch with a lamp at night.

haewon.title: First breath
haewon.task: Dive the Kelp Cathedral (15 m down, east of the Tide Clock) and put your hand on the anchor stone at its heart. Then come up. Breathe out slowly as you go down.

haewon.title: Sideways
haewon.task: Let a rip on the White Strand take you (a dark flat gap in the breakers, foam running out), then get out of it the right way: swim along the shore, not back to it.

haewon.title: A line on the reef
haewon.task: Harpoon 5 fish or creatures under the water: a thrown spear, a Whaler's harpoon, or the path's own throw.

haewon.title: Coral for the helm
haewon.task: Break tidecoral off the living reef (only under the water: it dies into stone in air), and make a diving helm at the armorer. Show it to Hae-won.

haewon.title: The stones say
haewon.task: Read all nine tsunami stones on the coast, or stand above their line when a King Tide comes back in.

haewon.title: Tie the Tyrant
haewon.task: Beat the Reef Tyrant, the great shark that swims the reef's loop and rests at the Mooring Stones, after tying it off on a mooring stone at least once (harpoon it, then E at a stone).
haewon.doneLine: Ha! It'll be telling the other sharks about you.

ilmari.title: First flush
ilmari.task: Build a log bed (Farm pieces), plant oyster cap spawn in it and harvest your first flush. Oyster caps grow in the dark: under a roof, or below.

ilmari.title: What grows on the dead
ilmari.task: Bring Ilmari 3 deepcaps. They grow only where something died: look for bones furred white, and the niches under the shrine.

ilmari.title: Cold light
ilmari.task: Carry cold light (a glow-cap lantern, glow paste, or a tamed Glowgrub with you) and walk the Lure Gallery from one end to the other without a lure line reeling you up.

ilmari.title: The lone cap
ilmari.task: A lone deepcap with no bones round it is a Rotmaw's lure. Strike the lure from range before it bursts out of its mound, then kill it.

ilmari.title: Down the Long Stair
ilmari.task: Light the Starfall Shrine under the False Sky and the Cable Shrine at the Shoestring Bridge.

ilmari.title: Cut the starfield
ilmari.task: Beat the Weaver. She sleeps in the False Sky by day and walks her loop at night; burn or blow down her webs and she's slow.
ilmari.doneLine: There. Now the stars are only stars.

yara.title: Feathers and stone
yara.task: Bring Yara 6 levistone (struck shards float: grab them inside 3 s) and 10 Puffwing feathers from the Feather Rookery.

yara.title: First flight
yara.task: Glide from the First Isle to Terrace Isle without touching ground between (any glider; find the lift to climb).
yara.doneLine: See? It holds you if you let it.

yara.title: Read the wind
yara.task: Ride three different updraft columns to their tops while gliding. Follow the Mistlarks: they circle every column.
yara.markName: The Cloud Gardens (Yara: the gardens' columns)

yara.title: Silk
yara.task: Bring 8 Skysilk wound from the gossamer drifts in the Cloud Gardens (hold E on a drift).

yara.title: The bridges
yara.task: Light the Toll Shrine on Last Toll, then cross the whole Broken Way from Tollgate to Brink without a lift or a mount.

yara.title: The first kite
yara.task: Bring Yara the rubbing of the First Kite's anchor, down in the Undercloud.
yara.doneLine: That's the door. I've seen it from the air. I never had the nerve.

yara.title: Grounded
yara.task: Show Yara a trophy (or its talisman) from each of Kyrra the Tempest Harrier, the Bridge Sentinel and Old Gulper.

quests._comment: Per master, in order. type: bring (items taken), show (items checked), kill (creature, count, optional status: burning / slowed), shrines (all listed lit by you), quench (hold a weapon of an element in water), sneak (within 5 m of a sleeping kind, then 30 m off while it sleeps), tame (creature). pays: xp to the master's path, items, recipes learned. The last four of each master's line are The Unlearning (arc: unlearning; its last step pays the Heron's draught: a respec, cooks/build-endgame.md 2.2). title_reward: a title the step gives.

sigrun.title: Quench
sigrun.task: Quench a fire-infused weapon: hold it in water.

sigrun.title: Kindle the vents
sigrun.task: Light the Glasswall, Blue Fire and Crater Rim shrines.

sigrun.title: Glass heart
sigrun.task: Show Sigrun the Obsidian Warden's heart.

sigrun.title: The yoke
sigrun.task: Kill Cinderhorn, the bull that walks the ash plains.

sigrun.title: The Unlearning: cold ashes
sigrun.task: Bring Sigrun 20 obsidian: the glass a fire path is made of, to be given up.

sigrun.title: The Unlearning: hot iron, cold water
sigrun.task: Quench a fire-infused weapon three times.

sigrun.title: The Unlearning: what the giant knew
The Unlearning: the heron's cup
sigrun.task: Bring Sigrun 5 frost essence: the draught is drunk cold.

ailu.title: Listen
ailu.task: Get within 5 m of a sleeping Gloomhowl and back out without waking it.

ailu.title: Slow the saber
ailu.task: Kill a Rimeclaw while it's slowed.

ailu.title: The Earth-Bull
ailu.task: Kill Old Tusker, the feral drudge bull.

ailu.title: The Unlearning: thin ice
ailu.task: Bring Áilu 20 blocks of ice: what a frost path is made of, to be given up.

ailu.title: The Unlearning: breath held
ailu.task: Get within 5 m of a sleeping Rimeclaw and back out without waking it.

ailu.title: The Unlearning: what the wyrm knew
The Unlearning: the heron's cup
ailu.task: Bring Áilu 5 ember essence: the draught is warmed by the other land.

vesna.title: Glass
vesna.task: Bring Vesna 6 stormglass: you'll have to be out after a storm.

vesna.title: The rod-road
vesna.task: Walk the rod-road from the middle camp to the Thunderstone Arch, touching its rods on the way.

vesna.title: Hair on end
vesna.task: Stand above 600 m in a Thunderstorm and live through 3 strikes' warnings without being struck.

vesna.title: Nine spans
vesna.task: Cross the Bridge of Nine Spans carrying a light and light the lanterns in its 8 winch huts.
vesna.doneLine: The fifth span? Its rope's still tied at the top. I'd not climb it. You would.

vesna.title: Banner
vesna.task: Show Vesna the Kite crown from Galvara's Eyrie.

vesna.title: The bell
vesna.task: Kill the Bellwether, the belled ram of the cliff paths.

vesna.title: The Crown
vesna.task: Reach the Ring by the Hanging Monastery and light the Hanging Shrine.

vesna.title: The Unlearning: spent glass
vesna.task: Bring Vesna 20 stormglass: what a lightning path is made of, to be given up.

vesna.title: The Unlearning: below the strike
vesna.task: Live through 3 more strikes' warnings above 600 m.

vesna.title: The Unlearning: what the roc knew
The Unlearning: the heron's cup
vesna.task: Bring Vesna 5 ember essence: the draught is lit by the other fire.

ruslana.title: Red moss
ruslana.task: Bring Ruslana 10 bloodmoss: it grows on the domes and round every bleedwater pool.

ruslana.title: What the water wants
ruslana.task: Wade bleedwater until it opens you up, then close the wound with a bloodmoss poultice.

ruslana.title: The duckweed rule
ruslana.task: Kill a Murkjaw on land: it has to die out of the water.

ruslana.title: A hex returned
ruslana.task: Curse your prey, then kill 3 creatures while the curse is on them.

ruslana.title: The Coven key
ruslana.task: Take the key from the skeleton in the Hanging Cypress's cage and open the trapdoor in the Walking House floor.
ruslana.doneLine: Mind the ladder. Thirty metres, and nobody's oiled it in a long while.

ruslana.title: Salt for the Bloat
ruslana.task: Beat The Bloat, and throw salt on it at least once in the fight.

morwen.title: Keep the light
morwen.task: Light the five dark tōrō on the north side of the Row of the Named after dark (hold a lit torch or lantern to each).

morwen.title: The first raise
morwen.task: Kill a Gravehound and raise it (Necromancy: Raise dead). Not a Necromancer? Butcher one down to its bones.

morwen.title: Iron for the dead
morwen.task: Break six mortsafes in the grave fields for their grave iron (a pick or a hammer).

morwen.title: What's under the yew
morwen.task: "The oldest one has roots for a roof." Find it and dig.

morwen.title: Count the bones
morwen.task: Bring Morwen the Ossuary ledger from the Sorting Room, down in the Ossuary.

morwen.title: The one who digs
morwen.task: Kill the Gravedigger on his night walk (by day he sleeps against the Watch House door).

saga_venn.title: Listen first
saga_venn.task: Strike the keystone chime in three different halls (the bronze chime under each hall's biggest cluster) and watch the hall light.

saga_venn.title: On the ring
saga_venn.task: Mine resonant crystal on the ring 8 times: strike a node again while it still rings (within a breath of the last strike) and it gives one more.

saga_venn.title: Drop the door
saga_venn.task: Drop three ward fields by hitting their lead keystone plates (an arrow, a thrown stone or a spell), not by walking through them attuned.

saga_venn.title: The quiet road
saga_venn.task: Cross the Organ, the long lava tube under the plateau, from one end to the other without an Echobat ever coming for you.

saga_venn.title: Two of one
saga_venn.task: Beat the Mirrored Twins in the Archive of Wards: only the real knight has a reflection in the water.

saga_venn.title: What the Vault keeps
saga_venn.task: Open the Silent Vault beyond the Echo Warden's hall and bring Saga the Carver's Chisel to touch (you keep it).

maren.title: Count the stones
maren.task: Throw a stone into 3 different rift zones and watch it float (make throwing stones by hand from stone).

maren.title: What the edge gives
maren.task: Mine 10 voidglass from the rings round the rifts. The ring drains you while you work.

maren.title: Salt and glass
maren.task: Bring Maren 6 grey salt from the Grey Strand's pans.

maren.title: The Choir's road
maren.task: Beat the Unravelled on the Cantor's Stair and the Mother of Rifts in the Rift Pens.

maren.title: Where it went
maren.task: Go down into the Great Rift and reach the last note, at the bottom of the Unmade Place.

maren.title: Empty
maren.task: Beat the Null Warden at the Null Gate.

rowan.title: Fallen, not felled
rowan.task: Bring Rowan 10 heartwood: from a fallen giant's broken end, never a standing tree.
rowan.doneLine: Fallen wood. That's the whole of it. The Grovekin never cut a living tree, and look how long they lasted.

rowan.title: Through the briars
rowan.task: Get through a thornbrake wall 8 m deep (any way: the path, briarproof leathers, a torch) and open the cache behind it.

rowan.title: Smoke and honey
rowan.task: Calm a wild hive with smoke (a torch held to it, or a smoke pot) and take its honey without a sting.
rowan.doneLine: Keep the wax. Four of it and some timber make you a hive of your own, if a Hiveback will have it.

rowan.title: The bent trees
rowan.task: Walk the Lost Path to its end: follow the trail trees' bent knees, not the foxfire.

rowan.title: The black laces
rowan.task: Bring Rowan 6 bootlace rhizomorph from the Hollow Root under the Eldest.
rowan.doneLine: Rot in a jar. It's the one thing the old god down there can't heal.

rowan.title: The Matron's skins
rowan.task: Beat the Grey Matron at the Bower by cutting her walkways down.
rowan.doneLine: Take the ring. I've no more use for it. You've the forest under your skin now.

trade._comment: Barter: give -> get, opened at a standing tier (0 Stranger .. 3 Kin). Discounts take off the give side (rounded up, at least 1).

messages._comment: Message stones (Elden Ring's frame): a template with **** for the word, an optional conjunction and a second clause. maxPerPlayer: the oldest crumbles. hideAt: net rating at or below this hides it. healFraction: what a Good gives the author (online, alive).

king_tide._why: cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.10: one game day (60 real minutes) about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: the sea draws back off the shelf, every chime beacon rings with no wind, the flocks lift inland, the drowned bell rings under the reef. The Low (50 min, -6 m): the flats, the dyke and the reef crest dry, the Low Gate open, stranded Kelpgrazers and Driftbacks (offer-food taming x3), pool-bound Reefjaws (x1.3 taken), Spinecrabs on the flats, tidecoral x3 and pearls x2; a spawning night if it falls 20:00-06:00 (every tidecoral regrows, Glowray rings tame x2). The Return: the white line and the roar at T-10 min, the 3 m bore at T-3 min to the Tsunami Line (80, carried 20 m, soaked; pieces below the line 200 once). WROceanHazards.cpp runs it (tuning tide.kingTide).
king_tide.title: The King Tide
king_tide.warn: The sea is drawing back off the shelf, and every shell-chime on the coast is ringing with no wind
king_tide.startText: The King Tide: the sea is out six metres. The reef stands dry, the Low Gate is open, and things are stranded on the flats. Be above the line of stones when it comes back
king_tide.endText: The sea is home again, to the stones and no further

events._comment: Settings worldEvents / biomeEvents (off / rare / normal / frequent). everyHours: real hours between, at Normal (rare x2, frequent x0.5), counted on the world's played time. maxBiome / maxWorld at once.

eruption.title: The volcano stirs
eruption.warn: Tremors under the ash: the crater is waking
eruption.startText: The Eruption: lava bombs over the volcanic lands
eruption.endText: The ash settles. Bomb cores cool on the ground

whiteout.title: A white wall
whiteout.warn: A white wall rolls off the glacier
whiteout.startText: Whiteout: you can't see 25 m; Gloomhowls hunt by day
whiteout.endText: The whiteout lifts. Tonight the aurora will be full

great_storm._why: cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.15: the Front (0-10 min), the Storm (10-50: strikes everywhere with the same tells, faster above 600 m; Raiju arrive in strikes; ball lightning on the Crags and the Cliff Shrines), the Clearing (50-60). Strikes never in claims or spawn camps. After: fulgurite x3 wherever strikes fell, the Glass Scar glows 2 game hours (WRStormWorld.cpp).
great_storm.title: The Great Storm
great_storm.warn: A black wall rises over the Crown: every rod in the peaks is humming
great_storm.startText: The Great Storm: lightning will fall everywhere in the peaks. Get low, get under rock, or ground yourself
great_storm.endText: The storm breaks. Steam off the rock, and fresh stormglass wherever it struck

red_tide._why: cooks/biome-swamp.md 2.10: one game day about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: the falls run oxblood, the Throat's mist doubles, the crows take off, the Coven pillar burns red. M3-M5 murk turns bleedwater with the leech boil; M1/M2 brackish stay clean; camps safe. WRSwampSystems.cpp drives AWRSwampState.
red_tide.title: The Red Tide
red_tide.warn: The falls are running dark red, and every crow in the Mire is in the air
red_tide.startText: The Red Tide: the pools inland have turned to blood. Keep to the coast, or wade at your own cost
red_tide.endText: The tide ebbs. The murk runs black again

riftstorm._why: biome-void 2.10: one game day about every 3 real days. Warning 5 min: the Great Rift's column thickens, every rift's inrush rises to a howl. 6 of the 10 seeds open as storm rifts with a rift heart; three waves 4 min apart walk to the nearest claim within 1.5 km, else the nearest shrine; closed rings pay voidglass x3; 1,500 path XP a closed rift. WRVoidHazards.cpp drives it.
riftstorm.title: The Rift Storm
riftstorm.warn: The Great Rift's light thickens and every tear in the Wasteland is howling
riftstorm.startText: The Rift Storm: new rifts are tearing open across the Wasteland. Break their hearts to close them
riftstorm.endText: The storm rifts close. The waves still walking keep walking

bloom._why: cooks/biome-forest.md 2.10, cooks/build-biome-forest.md 2.13: one game day (end = clock.dayMinutes x 60) about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: pollen haze off every F4/F5 giant, the Four Hearts' sap blazes, the Grovekin pillar on the Crown's Ring burns green. Then crops and wild nodes x2, rare seeds 10%, heartwood x3 and honey x2 (on the forest's own nodes: WRForestWorld, so signatureScale stays 1 here), three Elder Falls, the noon wasp raid, the Wild Hunt at night, Sylvaroth's lines x1.5. Camps, the village and claims stay safe. WRForestHazards.cpp runs it (tuning hazards.bloom).
bloom.title: The Bloom
bloom.warn: Gold pollen is drifting off the old giants, and the Four Hearts' sap is running bright
bloom.startText: The Bloom: the whole forest flowers at once. Everything grows twice as fast, heartwood comes three to a cut, and the dead giants are coming down
bloom.endText: The Bloom is over. The pollen settles, and the forest goes back to its slow time

turning_wind._why: cooks/biome-sky.md 2.15: one game day about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: a lenticular cap over the Flue, Kelvin-Helmholtz billows, every wind-pole's cloth swings against the wind, the Great Kite turns. Then the wind reverses (180 degrees over 2 min), small islands drift 40-120 m and hold, six cloud bridges, 20 shard falls, the Undercloud's gap opens wide, levistone x3. WRSkyWorld / WRSkyIsleTypes run it from AWRSkyState's times.
turning_wind.title: The Turning Wind
turning_wind.warn: A lens of cloud is forming over the Flue, and every wind-pole's cloth has swung round against the wind
turning_wind.startText: The Turning Wind: the sky's wind has reversed. Small islands are drifting, cloud bridges have formed between the islands, and levistone is falling off the drifting keels
turning_wind.endText: The wind swings back. The islands drift home, and the cloud bridges fray from the ends in

resonance._why: cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.10: one game day about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: the 40 Hz swell from the cave mouths, the chime stones ringing by themselves. Then a peal every 4 minutes out of the Prism Hall at 300 m/s: every crystal flares, chandeliers in its path fall, Echobats go deaf, nests crack. The first peal regrows every resonant node and splits the six singing geodes (resonant crystal x12, amethyst, a 10% chance of each found rune). Wards switch to pattern B; the Silent Vault won't open; resonant crystal x3. WRCrystalHazards.cpp runs it (tuning crystalEvents.resonance).
resonance.title: The Resonance
resonance.warn: A note too low to hear is rising out of every cave mouth, and the chime stones are ringing on their own
resonance.startText: The Resonance: the caves are singing. Every crystal is awake, the wards have shifted, and the singing geodes have split
resonance.endText: The last peal fades. The geodes close and the wards settle back

bloodmoon._why: cooks/biome-graveyard.md 2.10, build-biome-graveyard.md 2.12: the Blood Moon, about every 3 real days for one game day (so a whole night falls inside it) (Biome events setting). The 5 minute warning is its sign (the rust-red sky, the red moon over the chapel, every bell tolls once); 20:00-05:00 the Rising (corpse fog forced, corruption x2 on the land, Risen processions on the procession roads walking to the nearest light, vigil at camp safe zones, re-forming 6 min after destroyed; the Bell-Ringer tolls every 15 s, the Gravedigger digs two more graves, Necromancers' Souls x2 and raises x2); dawn: every procession Risen falls into a bone pile; the Mourning to the day's end. WRGraveEvents.cpp runs it (tuning graveyardEvents.bloodMoon).
bloodmoon.title: The Blood Moon
bloodmoon.warn: The moon is coming up red over the chapel, and the bells are moving on their own
bloodmoon.startText: The Blood Moon: when night falls, the dead of the Graveyard get up and walk the roads toward the lights
bloodmoon.endText: The Blood Moon is over. The Mourning lifts, and the graves are quiet again

sporefall._why: cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.10: one game day about every 3 real days (Biome events setting). Warning 5 min: the Breath turns gold and climbs to 800 m, every cavern glow beats at 35 a minute, every Puffball slips its tether and drifts up, the Deepfarmer pillar on the Crown's Ring burns cyan. Then the flush (pale caps with 6 m clouds over the seeded ground: the fungal surface, the Desert strip's north 400 m, the Spore Scar, Wheel Isle and the Lid Gate), the Flue's vents every 30 s, bloomed beasts (a cap on the back, bites +poison 20, burst on death), the noon summit of the bloomed passives, the Seed Vault open, deepcap x3. WRFungalEvents.cpp runs it (tuning fungalEvents.sporefall).
sporefall.title: The Sporefall
sporefall.warn: The Breath over the Great Doline has turned gold, and every glow in the caverns is beating like a heart
sporefall.startText: The Sporefall: the Deep is fruiting. Caps are bursting up across the cape, and anything that breathes too long in their clouds will carry one
sporefall.endText: The flush is over. The caps are falling back to dust, and on every high rock something small is facing the Breath

invasions._comment: Setting invasions: off / rare / normal / frequent = per pair per real week. Pairs list both ways; pass mouths are found from the island's 'pass' points (the attacking side's mouth = passInset metres into the attacker's land).

pairs._why: cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.21: dormant until the Desert is live. Sign: a wet-sand mark spreads up the pass and the Gate Shrine's brazier hisses out; the chime beacons along the road ring. Old Barnacle leads the Ocean side: Spinecrab ranks marching through the pass, Gullraider flocks over them, to the nearest Desert claim or shrine within 1.5 km of the west mouth.

cooks/biome-sky.md 2.16: dormant until the Fungal caverns are live. Sign: the Flue's updraft stops dead and reverses into a howling downdraft; Mistlarks flee the shaft. Wind invaders dive down the Flue to the nearest Fungal claim or shrine within 1.5 km of its floor.

cooks/biome-forest.md 2.21: dormant until the Graveyard is live (both lands must be live; the Rootgrave rockfall plug opens with the Graveyard lane). 8-14 of Thornlynx, Mossmaul, Rootcoil, Burlbeast (no passives) behind the Hornwarden, to the nearest Graveyard claim or shrine within 1.5 km of Rootgrave's west mouth. Sign: moss and flowers along their path for 30 min (the Graveyard lane draws it).

cooks/biome-forest.md 2.21: dormant until the Graveyard is live. 8-14 Graveyard creatures and its roaming mini (the R4 Graveyard cook names them: that lane fills leader/day/night) to the nearest forest claim or shrine within 1.5 km of Rootgrave's east mouth: the Canopy Shrine (-620, +3,050), then the Nurse Shrine. Sign: the Lantern Line's lanterns light by themselves 5 min before.

cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.22: the Crystal caves march west through the Severance, led by the Geode Tyrant (it leaves its round). Their noise lights the gorge's grey crystal veins as they pass (the sign on the Void side). Mouths in world metres: the gorge's east floor under the Hollowed Giantess, the Hollow Fort at its west end.

cooks/biome-void.md 2.22 / crystal 2.22: the Void comes east through the Severance Gate, led by the Echo; the Wardcarvers' ward fields still throw them twice as hard. Their target is the Severance Shrine or the nearest claim within 1.5 km. (Riftborn Prismbacks, crystal bodies gone grey, wait for their own row.)

cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.21: the Spore side. Sign 5 min: the Flue exhales a continuous cyan column and mycelium bridges grow up from the rim toward the W4 islands. 8-14 of Mycomite swarms, Sporestalkers (they climb the Flue's walls), Webspinners (they web the landings), a Puffball drift, led by the Weaver; they land on the Spore Scar, Wheel Isle and the Lid Gate and march on the Rose Shrine or the nearest W4 claim. Each invader that stands 4 s leaves a 3 m spore cloud for 2 game hours (WRFungalEvents).

rooms.name: Smiths' Hall
rooms.lore: Smith's tally: forty marks cut in the anvil's foot, and a forty-first half done.

rooms.name: The Sealed Vault
rooms.lore: Giant's first hammer-head, cracked through: the forge-giant was once small enough to need a smith.

rooms.name: The Burnt Wyrm
rooms.lore: Smith's spike: forged iron, driven into a wyrm's skull long before Skaldrith was hatched.

summoning._comment: A stone beside each major's shrine-stone and at each mini's lair. holdSeconds to offer; partyRadius: who stands with the summoner shares the fight. heard: the rising sound's reach.

night._comment: Night tables (spawn_regions.json night): aggro range for nocturnal hunters at night.
